name: robots/justyx404__spot_gazebo_ros2
title: Spot quadruped in an Ignition/Gazebo ROS 2 simulation
intro: Spot quadruped in an Ignition/Gazebo ROS 2 simulation, adapted from justyx404/spot_gazebo_ros2. It reads `read_odometry`, `read_joint_states` and `read_sim_clock`; runs `publish_velocity`. `publish_velocity`: publish one geometry_msgs/Twist on /cmd_vel; the receipt reports transmission and the three components handed to rosbridge, not motion, arrival or a stop. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
